name: Speedy Pork Sweet & Sour with Pineapple
steps: Cook rice according to pack instructions.
Slice pork into thin strips. Dice pepper. Mince garlic.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, tomato paste, honey and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.
Heat a wok over high heat with a little oil. Stir-fry pork 3–4 min until cooked through. Set aside.
Add pepper and garlic to the wok, stir-fry 2 min. Add pineapple and toss.
Return pork, pour over the sauce and stir-fry 1–2 min until glazed. Finish with sesame oil. Serve over rice.
